scope: Fresh CPU successor with schedule-preserving decoder translation; predecessor outcomes unchanged
objective: Summed terminal job completion, with raw summed task RTT reported separately
initialization: All prior hand starts plus chronological operation ranks from each non-delay schedule. Mapping must never worsen its feasible incumbent. Charge all construction and mapping work.
decoder_switch: When proposing under another decoder, first translate the current schedule into chronological start order, then mutate. Pure reservation search also considers mapped non-delay initialization.
selection: Lowest mean median-repeat cost among arms passing every calibration timing draw; frozen before fresh inputs
live_gate: Six small bridge parity runs, four calibration-selected runs, and 48 fresh baseline/control/reference runs, regardless of headroom outcome. Audit all operations and complete resource-event traces.
counting: Proposal counts exclude the extra deterministic decoder-materialization calls; all such calls are charged in wall-time comparisons and reproduced in fixed-step audits.
future_gates: Headroom alone cannot authorize training. Require a fresh stronger hand-reservation/lookahead and residual graph challenge, then matched training and a fresh live gate.
claim_limit: This repairs a search representation mismatch, not physical parity or old numerical results. A finite reference does not bound all possible learning improvements. No GPU in this stage.
